messages:
Maya K: quick heads-up, i'm starting my on-call shadow this week. first full primary shift Fri 2026-03-20 00:00 UTC. posting a short plan + questions.

Jia L: welcome Maya! :tada: who’s your secondary for evenings? also do you have runbook links?

Maya K: thanks! secondary is Jia for most evenings. runbook (read-only): https://redwood.example/runbooks/oncall/runtime-incident-playbook. must-skim pages: paging flow, model-fallback-matrix, customer-impact-triage.

Maya K: quick probes i'll use to verify alerts are wired up:
```
# check cluster model health
curl -sS https://api.redwood.internal/health | jq '.models[] | {name,status,latency_ms}'
# prefix cache hitrate (redis)
redis-cli -h cache1 info | grep -i hit
```

Omar R: note: new paging suppression for noisy 4xx — duplicates suppressed 90s then escalate. bot will post counts + incident URL.

Oncall Bot: Paging policy: primary after 2m, secondary after 6m. duplicate suppression 90s. policy doc: https://redwood.example/policies/paging

Sasha P: if you see 429 spike, quick mitigations: 1) disable aggressive client retries, 2) apply short-term ingress rate-limit, 3) rollback recent routing rule. see runbook -> mitigations for commands.

Maya K: perfect. handoff plan: i will post a 30-min-before swap note in this thread with state, active incidents, mitigations + next actions. what is our overlap window for Fri?

Jia L: 15-minute overlap by default. extend to 30 if you need.

Maya K: noted. coverage gap: APAC evenings (02:00-08:00 UTC) occasionally thin. fallback to regional on-call if surge. Omar, do you have fallback contacts?

Omar R: pinned in channel + runbook. quick copy: @Sasha P (primary APAC), @Nina H (secondary APAC), then @oncall-ops. use escalation template from runbook when paging across regions.

Maya K: onboarding shadow checklist (want to expand into doc—react if yes):
- Read: runtime incident playbook (paging, escalations)
- Do: trigger staged test alert and confirm page to phone
- Shadow: ride-along on at least one real pager event
- Practice: run mitigation steps in staging and test rollback

Sasha P: do the staging test asap. triggering command (staging only):
```
POST /internal/test-alert HTTP/1.1
Host: api-staging.redwood.internal
Content-Type: application/json

{"severity":"critical","service":"runtime-model-serving","message":"staging test ping for <your-name>"}
```

Maya K: i'll run that tonight at 23:00 UTC. another question — short template for initial customer-impact blurb? want something to paste into incident summary.

Jia L: keep it terse: 1) affected surface (textgen/embeddings/etc), 2) percent of traffic affected, 3) visible customer errors (503/429/timeout), 4) mitigation in-flight + next action. sample: "textgen: ~12% increased 5xx in us-east; 37% requests >500ms; mitigation: routing fallback to compact model in progress; next: enable cache-only mode"

Maya K: thanks, pinning that. operational tips from Omar?

Omar R: two quick checks before variant roll: 1) KV cache TTLs in dashboard (stale TTLs cause regressions), 2) cold-start series in traces (kernel-selection mismatch shows here).

Maya K: on handoffs — should i include token-cost burn snapshot for last hour? ops said that helps during cost-sensitive outages.

Sasha P: yes, include console > monitoring > per-route > last 1h screenshot. call out if cost delta >50% vs baseline.

Maya K: final availability windows (posting here so it's clear):
- Mon–Thu primary 18:00–02:00 UTC. Jia secondary 18:00–23:00 UTC.
- Fri primary 18:00–02:00 UTC. Jia covers 02:00–08:00 UTC on request.
- Sat shadow 00:00–08:00 UTC; Omar primary that block.

Jia L: SG. let's do a short shadow recap call Sat 09:00 UTC after your first weekend shadow.

Maya K: thanks all — i'll post the 30-min handoff update Fri at 01:30 UTC in this thread. DM me or ping here if you want to join the pairing. :wave:
